In the Spring 2026 quarter, I took ENVS 154: GIS for Environmental Applications, which ended with a group project addressing an environmental question of our choosing. Our group decided to ask: 

**How does human activity influence the relative abundance of native and non-native vegetation in Yosemite National Park? And do differing sampling methods impact the distribution of vegetation data?**

The process of scientific inquiry was more of a journey than I would have guessed, riddled with unexpected results and new interpretations. However, in the end, I was extremely satisfied with our final product. 

You can find the results of our analysis in our [ArcGIS Storymap](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/5a3e249d31b44234a28e4ff84100e382).
